title: Grown Ass Child
description:
On November 8th, 2023, officers responded to a hit-and-run incident. The victim informed the police that the suspect's vehicle was a silver Toyota Camry, and the driver fled the scene after the collision. Meanwhile, another officer located the woman who had struck the victim's car and interrogated her. The woman was still unwilling to provide any substantial details to the officers. She completely denied any involvement in an accident that day. Soon, the suspect's mother arrived at the scene. The woman was soon placed under arrest as the officers suspected she was driving under the influence. She was taken to the jail for further processing. She became very aggressive while the officer was explaining the process to her and later even fell off her chair. While being transported to the medical center, the woman repeatedly verbally abused the officer. She was charged with hit and run, driving with a suspended license, resisting arrest and DUI.

About Us / Disclaimer: 

Police Insider provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams. We believe this footage can be used as an educational guide for viewers.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.
